_note: More people to ask for money, on top of shop.json's lenders. min: meters (family, teammates...), 'friend:<id>' loyalty, 'partner' meter, 'agent' (must have one), 'pro' (on a professional contract). max can be 'wage4' (four weeks' wages).

mum.name: Mum (just Mum)
mum.line: She doesn't ask what it's for. She just looks at you. That's worse.

gran.name: Gran (from under the mattress)
gran.line: The notes smell of lavender and are from 1994. One's an old fiver. She wants it back with 'interest', which means visits.

priya.name: Priya
priya.line: She lends it with a spreadsheet and a repayment plan. Colour-coded. You've never felt so loved and so judged.

lee.name: Big Lee
lee.line: Cash, in a carrier bag, in a lay-by. 'No rush,' says Lee. Then, 'Actually, a bit of a rush.'

deano.name: Deano
deano.line: Deano gives you £40 and half a Twix. It's everything he has. You both cry a little.

stan.name: Stan
stan.line: Stan hands it over in a brown envelope. 'In my day we were paid in pies,' he says. 'Pay me back in pies.'

partner.name: Your other half
partner.line: They transfer it without a word. The silence at dinner is deafening.

agent.name: Your agent (an 'advance')
agent.line: Your agent advances you the money 'against future earnings'. They're already doing the sums. Out loud.

club.name: The club (advance on wages)
club.line: The club secretary sighs and processes an advance. Word gets round the dressing room by lunchtime.

captain.name: The club captain
captain.line: The skipper lends it, then announces it in the group chat 'for transparency'. Brilliant.
